interpretation.confidence: High: exact packaged source/docs and runtime 1368→684 size rejection agree, but the distributed stripped binary is not reproducibly linked bit-for-bit to the sample source.

phone_boundary: Source audit only; no model load, inference, compilation, or phone access occurred.

source_behavior: The packaged SampleApp defaults InputDataType to FLOAT unless an input-data-type option is supplied.
For a non-FLOAT32 graph tensor, IOTensor reads one FLOAT32 value per tensor element, then calls copyFromFloatToNative.
For QNN_DATATYPE_INT_64, copyFromFloatToNative calls castFromFloat<int64_t>, whose implementation static_casts each float value.
qairt.source_role: The installed SampleApp source is supporting implementation evidence, not a bit-for-bit source attestation for the stripped qnn-net-run binary.

required_fix.direct_qnn: Continue using graph descriptor INT64 buffers (1368 bytes AR171; 8 bytes AR1) with no qnn-net-run file conversion.
required_fix.qnn_net_run: For the actual qnn-net-run binary, use FLOAT32 files containing numeric 0..170/171 under default mode, or use documented global --use_native_input_files with native INT64 files of 1368/8 bytes. This preflight intentionally rejects every targeted --native_input_tensor_names form until exact graph/tensor selector grammar is validated. Do not rely on the SampleApp-only --input_data_type spelling.
